requestedExtensions.name: VK_KHR_robustness2
requestedExtensions.notes: NIR image load/store/atomic bounds lowering runs before descriptor lowering. On G925 v13, the Android robustness2 workload enabled robustBufferAccess2, robustImageAccess2, and nullDescriptor; all applicable OOB/null buffer, image, texel, descriptor-indexing, and update-after-bind cases passed. Null sampler is not applicable because nullDescriptor does not permit null sampler handles. CTS remains unrun.

requestedExtensions.name: VK_EXT_image_compression_control_swapchain
requestedExtensions.notes: Android WSI exposes compression control for swapchain images and forwards the flags to PanVK image creation. Fixed-rate modes are explicitly rejected because PanVK reports no fixed-rate compression support; only its existing lossless AFBC default/disabled behavior is available. PanProbe's swapchain_lifecycle test passed on the OnePlus 2602BPC18G (Mali-G925), creating swapchains with DEFAULT compression control.

requestedExtensions.name: VK_EXT_device_fault
requestedExtensions.notes: On CSF architectures PanVK preserves the first queue fault seen by queue-status checks. vkGetDeviceFaultInfoEXT returns one vendor record with raw CS_FAULT/CS_FAULT_INFO data (or the driver error code); raw info is not misreported as a decoded address. Vendor binary and address records are not advertised. Runtime fault injection has not been tested on G925.

requestedExtensions.name: VK_EXT_frame_boundary
requestedExtensions.notes: PanVK exposes the feature; Mesa's common queue runtime preserves VkFrameBoundaryEXT, frame ID, image/buffer handles, and tag data across legacy QueueSubmit conversion, queued submissions, and submit batching. PanProbe's swapchain_lifecycle test passed on the OnePlus 2602BPC18G (Mali-G925) and logged frame-boundary markers submitted for rendered frames. The marker is a tooling hint and does not change GPU execution; no profiling-tool consumer reads the retained metadata.

requestedExtensions.name: VK_EXT_pipeline_protected_access
requestedExtensions.notes: On the OnePlus 2602BPC18G (Mali-G925), PanProbe queried pipelineProtectedAccess=true and successfully created a device with VK_EXT_pipeline_protected_access enabled (PIPELINE_PROTECTED_ACCESS PASS feature-enable). protectedMemory remains unsupported: the Kbase protected-region query returned flags 0x280c without KBASE_REG_PROTECTED, so protected allocation correctly reports SKIP. Evidence: pipeline-protected-access-runtime.txt.

requestedExtensions.name: VK_EXT_subpass_merge_feedback
requestedExtensions.notes: PanVK's common vkCreateRenderPass2 path reports each subpass as unmerged, with unchanged post-merge indices/count. PanProbe's swapchain_lifecycle test passed on the OnePlus 2602BPC18G (Mali-G925), reporting status=12 and postMergeIndex=0 for the single-subpass render pass.
